brief:
Today, Monday 5 October, is Legs B. Your last logged session was Pull B on 3 October at the Singapore gym, and no leg session has been logged there yet. Every leg number on tonight's cards was earned in Warsaw or earlier, on other machines, so treat the first set of each lift as a test set: if the weight is clearly off, use the nearest setting that lets you hit the reps and log what you actually used. That log becomes the real starting point for this gym.

No weight goes up tonight. Leg curl (145 for 12 on all three sets), hip abductor and hip adductor (110 for 15 on both sets) had each earned a raise in Warsaw, but your trainers held them for one night until those numbers are confirmed on these machines. Two lifts get more work at a weight you have already done: RDL is 155, 175, 185, 185 for 8 each (a second set at 185), and leg press feet-high is 150, 170, 170 for 10 each (a second set at 170). Calf raise stays at 280 and asks for 13 on all three sets. Cable crunch stays at 55 and asks for 12 on all three. Hanging leg raise is 12 and 12.

No pain or soreness shows in any recent note. On 3 October the last three lifts (incline curl, reverse curl, face pulls) were typed in two days later and match the suggested numbers exactly, so your trainers will not raise those three off that entry. Please step on a scale: your last weigh-in was 207 lb on 23 August, 43 days ago, with the show 147 days out.
